corpus_module.name: TriadicFrameworks Corpus
corpus_module.description: Standalone module containing compressed README proxies for every named module in the TriadicFrameworks system. Each document is fully self-contained. No direct wiring between entries. Organized into 18 semantic bundle groups.

lineage.note: Each .md is a compressed README proxy for its named module. Corpus is its own standalone module — no direct wiring between entries. v2 is preserved as frozen lineage reference.

ai_metadata.retrieval_hint: Each document is a self-contained compressed README for its named module. Do not assume cross-document linking. Resolve by bundle group first, then by role.
